description: Source code implementing system entropy gathering functions for OpenSSL, including getrandom and urandom fallback mechanisms.

methods.name: boringssl_getrandom

methods.description: Initializes the entropy source, setting up /dev/urandom or getrandom support.

methods.description: Fills a buffer with entropy, using getrandom or /dev/urandom.
